"},{"id":519,"text":"local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))

local hoverHapticEffect = Instance.new("HapticEffect")
hoverHapticEffect.Name = "UIHoverEffect"
hoverHapticEffect.Type = Enum.HapticEffectType.UIHover

local clickHapticEffect = Instance.new("HapticEffect")
clickHapticEffect.Name = "UIClickEffect"
clickHapticEffect.Type = Enum.HapticEffectType.UIClick

local UIBlur = game.Lighting:WaitForChild("UIBlur")

function updateUIBlur()
	local enabled = false
	local panels = game.CollectionService:GetTagged("GamePanel")
	for _,panel:Frame in ipairs(panels) do
		local gui = panel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
		if panel.Visible and gui.Enabled then
			enabled = true
			break
		end
	end
	
	UIBlur.Enabled = enabled
	if enabled then
		--播放镜头duangduang
		local camTween =  game.TweenService:Create(workspace.Camera, TweenInfo.new(0.3,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,0,false),{FieldOfView = 100})
		camTween:Play()
	else
		--播放镜头duangduang
		local camTween =  game.TweenService:Create(workspace.Camera, TweenInfo.new(0.3,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.InOut,0,false),{FieldOfView = 70})
		camTween:Play()
	end
	
end

function playPanelAnim(panel:Frame,isOpen:boolean?)	
	local UIScale = panel:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIScale")
	if not UIScale then
		UIScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		UIScale.Parent = panel
	end 
	
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.3,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
	local propertyTable = {
		Scale = 1
	}
	if isOpen ~= false then
		UIScale.Scale = 0
		propertyTable.Scale = 1
	else
		UIScale.Scale = 1
		propertyTable.Scale = 0
	end

	local tween =  game.TweenService:Create(UIScale, tweenInfo,propertyTable)
	if isOpen == false then
		tween.Completed:Connect(function(playbackState)
			panel.Visible = false
		end)
	end
	tween:Play() --播放tween动画
end

updateUIBlur()

-- 界面
CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal("GamePanel",function(panel: Frame, connections: {RBXScriptConnection}) 
	local btn_close:GuiButton = panel:FindFirstChild("btn_close",true)
	if btn_close then
		btn_close.Activated:Connect(function(inputObject: InputObject, clickCount: number) 
			playPanelAnim(panel,false)	
		end)
	end

	panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function() 
		if panel.Visible then
			playPanelAnim(panel,true)	
		end
		updateUIBlur()
	end)
end)

-- 按钮
CommonFunc:GetInstanceTagAddedSignal("ButtonAnimation",function(btn: GuiButton, connections: {RBXScriptConnection}) 
	btn.HoverHapticEffect = hoverHapticEffect
	btn.PressHapticEffect = clickHapticEffect

	local originSize = btn.Size

	local UIScale = btn:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIScale")
	if not UIScale then
		UIScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
		UIScale.Parent = btn
	end
	local t = 0.05
	local tweenEnter = game.TweenService:Create(UIScale,TweenInfo.new(t),{
		Scale = UIScale.Scale * 1.1
	})
	local tweenExit = game.TweenService:Create(UIScale,TweenInfo.new(t),{
		Scale = UIScale.Scale
	})
	local tweenBegin = game.TweenService:Create(UIScale,TweenInfo.new(t),{
		Scale = UIScale.Scale * 0.9
	})
	table.insert(connections,btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function(x: number, y: number) 
		tweenEnter:Play()
	end))
	table.insert(connections,btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function(x: number, y: number) 
		tweenExit:Play()
	end))
	table.insert(connections,btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject) 
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			tweenBegin:Play()
		end
	end))
	table.insert(connections,btn.InputEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject) 
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			tweenExit:Play()
		end
	end))
	table.insert(connections,btn.Activated:Connect(function(inputObject: InputObject, clickCount: number) 
		script:WaitForChild("Button_Down"):Play()	
	end))
end)"},{"id":520,"text":"-- 手柄控制器（Wild West）
-- GamepadOnly Attribute：当前输入模式为手柄时显示，否则隐藏
-- B键兜底：关闭当前最高层已打开的 UI

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer      = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui        = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- ============================================================
-- GamepadOnly Attribute
-- ============================================================

local function isGamepadInputType(inputType)
	local inputName = inputType and inputType.Name
	return type(inputName) == "string" and inputName:match("^Gamepad") ~= nil
end

local function hasConnectedGamepad()
	return #UserInputService:GetConnectedGamepads() > 0
end

local function shouldShowGamepadUI()
	return hasConnectedGamepad() and isGamepadInputType(UserInputService:GetLastInputType())
end

local function refreshAllTagged()
	local visible = shouldShowGamepadUI()
	for _, inst in ipairs(PlayerGui:GetDescendants()) do
		if inst:IsA("GuiObject") and inst:GetAttribute("GamepadOnly") then
			inst.Visible = visible
		end
	end
end

PlayerGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
	if inst:IsA("GuiObject") and inst:GetAttribute("GamepadOnly") then
		inst.Visible = shouldShowGamepadUI()
	end
end)

UserInputService.LastInputTypeChanged:Connect(refreshAllTagged)
UserInputService.GamepadConnected:Connect(refreshAllTagged)
UserInputService.GamepadDisconnected:Connect(refreshAllTagged)
task.defer(refreshAllTagged)

-- ============================================================
-- UI 栈：追踪当前打开的 RootFrame，B键兜底关闭
-- 各 UI 自身已通过 ContextActionService / InputBegan 处理 B 键，
-- 此处仅作兜底以防漏网。
-- ============================================================

local openStack = {}

local function stackRemove(frame)
	for i = #openStack, 1, -1 do
		if openStack[i] == frame then
			table.remove(openStack, i)
			return
		end
	end
end

local function watchFrame(frame)
	if not frame then return end
	frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
		if frame.Visible then
			stackRemove(frame)
			table.insert(openStack, frame)
		else
			stackRemove(frame)
		end
	end)
	if frame.Visible then
		table.insert(openStack, frame)
	end
end

-- 监听 Wild West 实际存在的主面板
local function setupWatchers()
	local function getRootFrame(screenName)
		local screen = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild(screenName)
		return screen and screen:FindFirstChild("RootFrame")
	end
	watchFrame(getRootFrame("UICraftItem"))
	watchFrame(getRootFrame("UIBusiness"))
	watchFrame(getRootFrame("UICraftBullet"))
	--watchFrame(getRootFrame("UIMap"))
end

task.defer(setupWatchers)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if gameProcessed then return end
	if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 then return end
	refreshAllTagged()
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB and #openStack > 0 then
		openStack[#openStack].Visible = false
	end
end)

local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CommonFunc = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("framework"):WaitForChild("CommonFunc"))
local GameEnum = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("GameEnum"))
local UIHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("UIHelper"))
local GameHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("GameHelper"))
local ToolHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ToolHelper"))
local CraftItemHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("CraftItemHelper"))
local ResourcesItemHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("ResourcesItemHelper"))
local BackpackModeHelper = require(game.ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("src"):WaitForChild("Helpers"):WaitForChild("BackpackModeHelper"))


local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = LocalPlayer.Character
local Backpack = ToolHelper:GetBackpack(LocalPlayer)
local UIBagpack:ScreenGui = UIHelper:GetScreen("UIBagpack")
local RootFrame:Frame = UIHelper:GetRootGUI("UIBagpack")
if not RootFrame then return end
local GameBackpackFrame:Frame = UIBagpack and UIBagpack:FindFirstChild("GameBackpack")
if not BackpackModeHelper:IsLegacy() then
    RootFrame.Visible = false
    if GameBackpackFrame then
        GameBackpackFrame.Visible = true
    end
    return
end
if GameBackpackFrame then
    GameBackpackFrame.Visible = false
end
local SlotParent:Frame = RootFrame.SlotParent

SlotPrefab.Visible = false
StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.Backpack,false)

local _changed = false
local _slots:{GuiButton} = {}
local _dragSlot:GuiButton -- 拖拽的item
local _holdSlot:GuiButton -- 按下的item
local _enterSlot:GuiButton -- 鼠标/手指停留的item
local _holdStart:number -- 按下的时间
local _moveCon:RBXScriptConnection -- 拖拽监听

local HOLD_TIME = 0.3

-- local _myToolsIds:{number} = ToolHelper.myToolsType
local _myToolsByKey:{string} = ToolHelper.myToolsType
local _myToolsMap:{{Tool}} = ToolHelper.myToolsMap

local _indexMap = {}
_indexMap[GameEnum.Tag.Bag] = 1
_indexMap[GameEnum.Tag.Axe] = 2
_indexMap[GameEnum.Tag.Lamp] = 3

local keyBoardBinds = {Enum.KeyCode.One,Enum.KeyCode.Two,Enum.KeyCode.Three,Enum.KeyCode.Four,Enum.KeyCode.Five,Enum.KeyCode.Six,Enum.KeyCode.Seven,Enum.KeyCode.Eight,Enum.KeyCode.Nine,Enum.KeyCode.Zero}

function getKey(tool:Tool)
    if CraftItemHelper:IsCraftTool(tool) then
        local lo = CraftItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
        return string.format("BluePrint_%d",lo.id)
    elseif ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(tool) then
        local lo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
        return string.format("ResItem_%d",lo.id)
    end

    return tool.Name
end

function init()
    local isNeedSort = #_myToolsByKey == 0
    local equippedTool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(LocalPlayer)
    if equippedTool then
        onAddedTool(equippedTool)
    end
    for _,tool:Tool in ipairs(Backpack:GetChildren()) do
        if tool.ClassName == "Tool" then
            onAddedTool(tool)
        end
    end
    _changed = true
    if isNeedSort then
        task.delay(1,sortTools)
    end
end

function sortTools()
    table.sort(_myToolsByKey,function(akey,bkey)
        local a = _myToolsMap[akey][1]
        local b = _myToolsMap[bkey][1]
        local aLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(a)
        local bLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(b)

        local aOrder = aLo and _indexMap[aLo.ItemType] or 99
        local bOrder = bLo and _indexMap[bLo.ItemType] or 99

        return bOrder - aOrder > 0
    end)
    _changed = true
end

function createSlot(i:number)
    local slot = SlotPrefab:Clone()
    slot.Name = tostring(i)
    slot.LayoutOrder = i
    slot.Active = true
    slot.Parent = SlotParent

    slot.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function(x, y)
        if _holdSlot then return end
        if not GameHelper:isAlive(LocalPlayer) then return end
        if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.TempRagdoll) then return end

        _enterSlot = slot
        _holdSlot = slot
        _holdStart = tick()
		local n = _holdStart
        task.wait(HOLD_TIME)
        if _holdSlot == slot and _holdStart == n then
            local absoluteSize = slot.AbsoluteSize
            local mousePos = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
            if not UIBagpack.IgnoreGuiInset then
                local GuiInset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
                mousePos -= GuiInset
            end
            _dragSlot = slot:Clone()
            _dragSlot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.one / 2
            _dragSlot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(absoluteSize.X * 1.5,absoluteSize.Y * 1.5)
			_dragSlot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mousePos.X,mousePos.Y)
            _dragSlot.Parent = UIBagpack
			_moveCon = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
				if _holdSlot and _holdSlot == slot then
                    local inputType = input.UserInputType
					if inputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
						local pos = input.Position
						if _dragSlot then
						    _dragSlot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X,pos.Y)
                        end
					end
				end
			end)
        end
    end)

    slot.MouseEnter:Connect(function(x, y)
        _enterSlot = slot
    end)
    slot.MouseLeave:Connect(function(x, y)
        task.wait()
        if _enterSlot == slot then
            _enterSlot = nil
        end
    end)

    return slot
end

function onAddedTool(tool:Tool)
    local key = getKey(tool)
    if not key then return end

    if not table.find(_myToolsByKey,key) then
        local layoutOrder = nil
        if ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(tool) then
            local resItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
            if resItemLo then
                layoutOrder = _indexMap[resItemLo.ItemType]
            end
        end
        if layoutOrder then
            if _myToolsByKey[layoutOrder] then
                table.insert(_myToolsByKey,layoutOrder,key)
            else
                _myToolsByKey[layoutOrder] = key
            end
        else
            table.insert(_myToolsByKey,key)
        end
    end

    if not _myToolsMap[key] then
        _myToolsMap[key] = {}
    end
    if not table.find(_myToolsMap[key],tool) then
        table.insert(_myToolsMap[key],tool)
    end

    _changed = true
end

function onRemovedTool(tool:Tool)
    local key = getKey(tool)
    if not key then return end
    if _myToolsMap[key] then
        local index = table.find(_myToolsMap[key],tool)
        if index then
            table.remove(_myToolsMap[key],index)
        end

        if #_myToolsMap[key] <= 0 then
            index = table.find(_myToolsByKey,key)
            if index then
                table.remove(_myToolsByKey,index)
            end
        end
    end
    _changed = true
end

function refreshView()
    local toolAmount = #_myToolsByKey
    local slotAmount = #_slots
    local num = math.max(toolAmount,slotAmount)
    local equippedToolKey = getEquippedToolKey()
    for i=1,num do
        local slot:GuiButton = _slots[i]
        local key = _myToolsByKey[i]
        if i <= toolAmount then
            local tools = _myToolsMap[key]
            local tool = tools[1]
            if not slot then
                slot = createSlot(i)
                _slots[i] = slot
            end
            local t_name:TextLabel = slot.t_name
            local t_num:TextLabel = slot.t_num
            local t_amount:TextLabel = slot.t_amount
            local Equided:Frame = slot.Equided

            if i < 10 then
                t_num.Text = tostring(i)
            elseif i == 10 then
                t_num.Text = tostring(0)
            else
                t_num.Visible = false
            end

            if #tools > 1 then
                t_amount.Visible = true
                t_amount.Text = string.format("x%d",#tools)
            else
                t_amount.Visible = false
            end

            t_name.Text = tool.Name
            Equided.Visible = key == equippedToolKey
        end
        if slot then
            slot.Visible = i <= toolAmount
        end
    end
end

function getEquippedToolKey()
    local equippedTool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(LocalPlayer)
    if not equippedTool then return end
    return getKey(equippedTool)
end

function triggerSlot(toolKey:string)
    if not GameHelper:isAlive(LocalPlayer) then return end

    local equippedToolKey = getEquippedToolKey()
    if toolKey == equippedToolKey then
        ToolHelper:UnequipTools()
    elseif equippedToolKey then
        task.spawn(function()
            local tools = _myToolsMap[toolKey]
            ToolHelper:EquipTool(nil,tools[1])
        end)
    elseif toolKey then
        local tools = _myToolsMap[toolKey]
        ToolHelper:EquipTool(nil,tools[1])
    end
    _changed = true
end

function onHoldEnd()
-- local _dragSlot:GuiButton -- 拖拽的item
-- local _holdSlot:GuiButton -- 按下的item
-- local _enterSlot:GuiButton -- 鼠标/手指停留的item
-- local _holdStart:number -- 按下的时间
-- local _moveCon:RBXScriptConnection -- 拖拽监听
-- if not _holdSlot then return end
    if _dragSlot then
        _dragSlot:Destroy()
        _dragSlot = nil
    end
    if _moveCon then
        _moveCon:Disconnect()
        _moveCon = nil
    end
    if _holdSlot then
        if tick() - _holdStart > HOLD_TIME then
            if GuiService.SelectedObject then
                local index = table.find(_slots,GuiService.SelectedObject)
                if index then
                    _enterSlot = _slots[index]
                end
            end
            -- 拖拽判断
            if _enterSlot and _enterSlot ~= _holdSlot then
                local oldIndex = _holdSlot.LayoutOrder
                local newIndex = _enterSlot.LayoutOrder
                local toolKey = table.remove(_myToolsByKey,oldIndex)
                if toolKey then
                    table.insert(_myToolsByKey,newIndex,toolKey)

                    -- 刷新排序
                    -- for order,id in ipairs(_myToolsIds) do
                    --     local lo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(id)
                    --     _indexMap[lo.ItemType] = order
                    -- end

                    -- 通知更新
                    _changed = true
                end
            end
        else
            -- 点击判断
            if _enterSlot == _holdSlot then
                triggerSlot(_myToolsByKey[_holdSlot.LayoutOrder])
            end
        end
    end

    _holdSlot = nil
end

function onInputBegan(input:InputObject, gameProcessed)
    if not GameHelper:isAlive(LocalPlayer) then return end
    if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.TempRagdoll) then return end
    local changedToolKey:number = nil
	if not gameProcessed then
        for i = 1,#_myToolsByKey do
            if input.KeyCode == keyBoardBinds[i] then
                changedToolKey = _myToolsByKey[i]
                break
            end
        end
    end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1 then
        local equippedToolKey = getEquippedToolKey()
        if equippedToolKey then
            local index = table.find(_myToolsByKey,equippedToolKey)
            index -= 1
            if index <= 0 then
                index = #_myToolsByKey
            end
            changedToolKey = _myToolsByKey[index]
        else
            changedToolKey = _myToolsByKey[#_myToolsByKey]
        end
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1 then
        local equippedToolKey = getEquippedToolKey()
        if equippedToolKey then
            local index = table.find(_myToolsByKey,equippedToolKey)
            index += 1
            if index > #_myToolsByKey then
                index = 1
            end
            changedToolKey = _myToolsByKey[index]
        else
            changedToolKey = _myToolsByKey[1]
        end
    end

    if changedToolKey then
        triggerSlot(changedToolKey)
    end
end

init()
Backpack.ChildAdded:Connect(function(tool)
	if tool.ClassName == "Tool" then
        onAddedTool(tool)
	end
end)
Backpack.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(tool)
	if tool.ClassName == "Tool" then
        if not tool:IsDescendantOf(character) then
            onRemovedTool(tool)
        end
        -- local equippedTool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(LocalPlayer)
        -- if equippedTool ~= tool then
        --     onRemovedTool(tool)
        -- end
	end
end)
character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(tool)
	if tool.ClassName == "Tool" then
        _changed = true
	end
end)
character.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(tool)
	if tool.ClassName == "Tool" then
        if not tool:IsDescendantOf(Backpack) then
            onRemovedTool(tool)
        end
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(onInputBegan)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gameProcessedEvent)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		onHoldEnd()
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonA then
        onHoldEnd()
	end
end)
UserInputService.TouchEnded:Connect(onHoldEnd)

while true do
    if _changed then
        _changed = false
        refreshView()
    end
    task.wait(0.1)
end"},{"id":525,"text":"local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

						local pos = input.Position
						if _dragSlot then
						    _dragSlot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pos.X,pos.Y)
                        end
					end
				end
			end)
        end
    end)

    slot.MouseEnter:Connect(function(x, y)
        _enterSlot = slot
    end)
    slot.MouseLeave:Connect(function(x, y)
        task.wait()
        if _enterSlot == slot then
            _enterSlot = nil
        end
    end)

    return slot
end

function onAddedTool(tool:Tool)
    local key = getKey(tool)
    if not key then return end

    if not table.find(_myToolsByKey,key) then
        local layoutOrder = nil
        if ResourcesItemHelper:IsResourcesItem(tool) then
            local resItemLo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLoByItem(tool)
            if resItemLo then
                layoutOrder = _indexMap[resItemLo.ItemType]
            end
        end
        if layoutOrder then
            if _myToolsByKey[layoutOrder] then
                table.insert(_myToolsByKey,layoutOrder,key)
            else
                _myToolsByKey[layoutOrder] = key
            end
        else
            table.insert(_myToolsByKey,key)
        end
    end

    if not _myToolsMap[key] then
        _myToolsMap[key] = {}
    end
    if not table.find(_myToolsMap[key],tool) then
        table.insert(_myToolsMap[key],tool)
    end

    _changed = true
end

function onRemovedTool(tool:Tool)
    local key = getKey(tool)
    if not key then return end
    if _myToolsMap[key] then
        local index = table.find(_myToolsMap[key],tool)
        if index then
            table.remove(_myToolsMap[key],index)
        end

        if #_myToolsMap[key] <= 0 then
            index = table.find(_myToolsByKey,key)
            if index then
                table.remove(_myToolsByKey,index)
            end
        end
    end
    _changed = true
end

function refreshView()
    local toolAmount = #_myToolsByKey
    local slotAmount = #_slots
    local num = math.max(toolAmount,slotAmount)
    local equippedToolKey = getEquippedToolKey()
    for i=1,num do
        local slot:GuiButton = _slots[i]
        local key = _myToolsByKey[i]
        if i <= toolAmount then
            local tools = _myToolsMap[key]
            local tool = tools[1]
            if not slot then
                slot = createSlot(i)
                _slots[i] = slot
            end
            local t_name:TextLabel = slot.t_name
            local t_num:TextLabel = slot.t_num
            local t_amount:TextLabel = slot.t_amount
            local Equided:Frame = slot.Equided

            if i < 10 then
                t_num.Text = tostring(i)
            elseif i == 10 then
                t_num.Text = tostring(0)
            else
                t_num.Visible = false
            end

            if #tools > 1 then
                t_amount.Visible = true
                t_amount.Text = string.format("x%d",#tools)
            else
                t_amount.Visible = false
            end

            t_name.Text = tool.Name
            Equided.Visible = key == equippedToolKey
        end
        if slot then
            slot.Visible = i <= toolAmount
        end
    end
end

-- 检测过时物品
function checkObsoleteTools()
    local myBackpack = ToolHelper:GetBackpack(LocalPlayer)
    for _,tools in pairs(_myToolsMap) do
        for _,tool in ipairs(tools) do
            if not tool:IsDescendantOf(myBackpack) and not tool:IsDescendantOf(character) then
                onRemovedTool(tool)
            end
        end
    end
end

function getEquippedToolKey()
    local equippedTool = ToolHelper:GetToolsInHand(LocalPlayer)
    if not equippedTool then return end
    return getKey(equippedTool)
end

function triggerSlot(toolKey:string)
    if not GameHelper:isAlive(LocalPlayer) then return end

    local equippedToolKey = getEquippedToolKey()
    if toolKey == equippedToolKey then
        ToolHelper.UnequipToolsC2S:FireServer()
    elseif equippedToolKey then
        task.spawn(function()
            local tools = _myToolsMap[toolKey]
            ToolHelper.EquipToolC2S:FireServer(tools[1])
        end)
    elseif toolKey then
        local tools = _myToolsMap[toolKey]
        ToolHelper.EquipToolC2S:FireServer(tools[1])
    end
    _changed = true
end

function onHoldEnd()
-- local _dragSlot:GuiButton -- 拖拽的item
-- local _holdSlot:GuiButton -- 按下的item
-- local _enterSlot:GuiButton -- 鼠标/手指停留的item
-- local _holdStart:number -- 按下的时间
-- local _moveCon:RBXScriptConnection -- 拖拽监听
-- if not _holdSlot then return end
    if _dragSlot then
        _dragSlot:Destroy()
        _dragSlot = nil
    end
    if _moveCon then
        _moveCon:Disconnect()
        _moveCon = nil
    end
    if _holdSlot then
        if tick() - _holdStart > HOLD_TIME then
            if GuiService.SelectedObject then
                local index = table.find(_slots,GuiService.SelectedObject)
                if index then
                    _enterSlot = _slots[index]
                end
            end
            -- 拖拽判断
            if _enterSlot and _enterSlot ~= _holdSlot then
                local oldIndex = _holdSlot.LayoutOrder
                local newIndex = _enterSlot.LayoutOrder
                local toolKey = table.remove(_myToolsByKey,oldIndex)
                if toolKey then
                    table.insert(_myToolsByKey,newIndex,toolKey)

                    -- 刷新排序
                    -- for order,id in ipairs(_myToolsIds) do
                    --     local lo = ResourcesItemHelper:GetLo(id)
                    --     _indexMap[lo.ItemType] = order
                    -- end

                    -- 通知更新
                    _changed = true
                end
            end
        else
            -- 点击判断
            if _enterSlot == _holdSlot then
                triggerSlot(_myToolsByKey[_holdSlot.LayoutOrder])
            end
        end
    end

    _holdSlot = nil
end

function onInputBegan(input:InputObject, gameProcessed)
    if not GameHelper:isAlive(LocalPlayer) then return end
    if character:HasTag(GameEnum.Tag.TempRagdoll) then return end
    local changedToolKey:number = nil
	if not gameProcessed then
        for i = 1,#_myToolsByKey do
            if input.KeyCode == keyBoardBinds[i] then
                changedToolKey = _myToolsByKey[i]
                break
            end
        end
    end

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1 then
        local equippedToolKey = getEquippedToolKey()
        if equippedToolKey then
            local index = table.find(_myToolsByKey,equippedToolKey)
            index -= 1
            if index <= 0 then
                index = #_myToolsByKey
            end
            changedToolKey = _myToolsByKey[index]
        else
            changedToolKey = _myToolsByKey[#_myToolsByKey]
        end
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1 then
        local equippedToolKey = getEquippedToolKey()
        if equippedToolKey then
            local index = table.find(_myToolsByKey,equippedToolKey)
            index += 1
            if index > #_myToolsByKey then
                index = 1
            end
            changedToolKey = _myToolsByKey[index]
        else
            changedToolKey = _myToolsByKey[1]
        end
    end

    if changedToolKey then
        triggerSlot(changedToolKey)
    end
end
